quarterly_data.quarter: LS Marine Solution IR presentation: KIND 19281 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IR deck lists the company as selected preferred bidder for four domestic offshore wind projects: Yeonggwang Anma 1-2 (532 MW, developer Anma Offshore Wind / Equis; external-grid contract KRW 94 billion; schedule undecided, tentatively suspended), Sinan Haesong 1-3 (1 GW, developer CIP/COP; construction planned 2030, commercial operation 2031), Sinan Ui (396 MW, developer Hanwha Ocean; construction planned 2027, commercial operation 2028) and Taean (504 MW, developer VenaEnergy + CIP; construction planned 2028, commercial operation 2029).
quarterly_data.figure: Anma 1-2 532 MW (KRW 94 billion contract); Haesong 1-3 1 GW; Sinan Ui 396 MW; Taean 504 MW

quarterly_data.quarter: LS Marine Solution IR presentation: KIND 19281 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company estimate of its West Coast HVDC opportunity: the offshore HVDC grid (8 GW as 525 kV 2 GW x 4 lines, 1,074 km, 2026-2038, first leg Saemangeum-Hwaseong targeted for 2030) has a total expected project cost of about KRW 122 trillion, of which HVDC subsea cable installation is estimated at about KRW 3.3 trillion. The company describes itself as the only domestic company able to install West Coast HVDC subsea cable. Roadmap: business diversification in 2026 (SOV, power-cable maintenance), new vessel introduction and overseas expansion in 2028, completion of the energy highway phase 1 in 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: HVDC subsea installation scope about KRW 3.3 trillion of about KRW 122 trillion total; 8 GW, 1,074 km

quarterly_data.quarter: LS Marine Solution IR presentation: KIND 19281 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fleet as presented: the new-build CLV has a 13,000 t payload (19,000 t gross) for high-capacity, deep-water lay and burial usable in Asia, Europe and North America; the upgraded GL2030 has a 7,000 t payload (9,000 t gross); the company presents the largest domestic fleet and equipment (Segero, Miraero, GL2030, T800 ROV, QT1500, vertical injector) including gear for burial in water under 5 m deep.
quarterly_data.figure: CLV payload 13,000 t (gross 19,000 t); GL2030 payload 7,000 t (gross 9,000 t)
